hypotheses.P1_top8_beats_random_distribution: Mean held-out causal fidelity of the frozen top-eight set exceeds the 95th percentile of sixteen random-eight sets.
hypotheses.P2_top16_beats_random_distribution: Mean held-out causal fidelity of the frozen top-sixteen set exceeds the 95th percentile of sixteen random-sixteen sets.
hypotheses.P3_top8_has_lower_adjoint_error: Mean held-out weighted adjoint error of top eight is below the 5th percentile of random-eight errors.
hypotheses.P4_top16_has_lower_adjoint_error: Mean held-out weighted adjoint error of top sixteen is below the 5th percentile of random-sixteen errors.
hypotheses.P5_specific_native_head_sparsity_survive: P1 and P3 both hold for rank eight.
